name: xStocks
steps: Check you are allowed in. The terms say: "We currently do not permit participation by persons located in or associated with the United States or any sanctioned country." The list of other excluded countries is below.
Open defi.xstocks.fi/points from a link you typed yourself, connect that wallet and sign the message to register. Registering means you accept the xPoints terms. Never enter a seed phrase anywhere.
Hold the xStocks, or supply them to a lending market or a liquidity pool that accepts them. Points are tracked automatically.
Do the extras if you want: the daily spin, the social quests, protocol quests and your referral link.
Optionally, until 4 December 2026, buy xStocks inside Solflare for the 5% to 20% boost. Solflare does not sell xStocks in the US, Canada, the UK, Australia or Nigeria.
Stay active. "New accounts that show no activity and no eligibility within 7 days of registration will be automatically removed."
what: No xStocks airdrop is promised. xPoints reward holding, lending or pooling xStocks onchain, and a Solflare boost runs to 4 December. US users are excluded.
behind: xStocks was built by Backed Finance, a Swiss company. The xStocks web app is run by Backed Finance AG in Zug, and the tokens are issued by Backed Assets (JE) Limited in Jersey. Kraken agreed to buy Backed Finance on 2 December 2025 for an undisclosed sum, as Ledger Insights and Banking Dive reported. The site footer now names Payward, Kraken's parent, and the X profile reads "xStocks by @Payward."
costs: Registering a wallet is free apart from signing a message. Earning points is not: you need xStocks in the wallet, which means buying tokenized shares with real money. Every buy, transfer, deposit into a lending market or pool, and withdrawal pays network gas. Solflare says it charges no fee of its own on xStocks trades, only the Solana network fee. The Solflare boost starts at $100 of xStocks boug
risks: US persons are excluded from xPoints and from xStocks. The homepage adds: "xStocks are not available to residents of the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, or sanctioned jurisdictions." Backed prohibits Iran, North Korea, Syria and the United States. It does not serve Afghanistan, Belarus, Central African Republic, DR Congo, Cuba, Ethiopia, Haiti, Iraq, Lebanon, Libya, Mali, Mozambi
